game: Resident Evil: Umbrella Corps (2016), Windows PC Completion Route
target: Spoiler-free total completion: tutorials, all Experiment trials and rewards, every online mode and map, all U-Trial medals, weapons, attachments, progression, customization, updates, and DLC

areas.name: PC Route and Service
areas.location_cue: The Steam library, installed-content manager, ranked lobby, and profile statistics screens.
areas.note: The offline Experiment remains usable alone; persistent multiplayer completion depends on live ranked results and arranged players.

levels.1: Use the native release selected for Sami's capture setup.
levels.2: Install Umbrella Corps from the owned Steam library entry.
levels.3: Use the native Windows release and update it to the final Steam revision. No verified PlayStation-exclusive gameplay requires a secondary pass; keep all progression on one Steam profile.

levels.1: Confirm the base game and optional packs before planning multiplayer.
levels.2: Check that the base game, Upgrade Pack, and Fashion Victim Pack are owned or intentionally excluded.
levels.3: As of 2026-07-16, the base game and both packs remain listed on Steam. Capture the owned-content screen, install every purchased entitlement, and launch once online so licenses and update content populate the customization menus.

levels.1: Test persistent multiplayer before beginning any cumulative record.
levels.2: Finish one ranked match and verify rank, U-Trial, and weapon progress at the result screen.
levels.3: Create or join a ranked lobby with arranged players, finish without anyone leaving, and inspect the profile afterward. Do not begin the 500-match ledger until player rank, weapon XP, U-Trial counters, and the result itself all save correctly.

levels.1: A complete private group avoids the nearly empty public queue.
levels.2: Prepare two coordinated teams of three before entering ranked matchmaking.
levels.3: Organize six current PC players, agree on lobby timing and objective rotations, and use voice communication. Progress-sensitive tasks must be completed in ranked matches; ordinary free or friend-only rooms may not update the same counters.

levels.1: The final update permits smaller matches under specific lobby conditions.
levels.2: Test the post-update four-player countdown in One Life and Multi-Mission.
levels.3: Enter the same ranked queue with four arranged players and no full three-person squad blocking the fallback. Allow the countdown to start naturally, finish one result, and verify progression before using this smaller setup for any grind.

levels.1: Online counters deserve a dated record after each long session.
levels.2: Capture rank, every U-Trial page, weapon levels, and customization totals.
levels.3: Take dated menu captures after each planned block and preserve the Steam userdata and configuration folders while the client is closed. Server-side or matchmaking records cannot be reconstructed from this guide if access changes later.

save_backup.title: Preserve the working online profile
save_backup.why: Legacy population and old online counters may become harder to reproduce.
save_backup.detail: Capture the complete profile and copy local Steam data after every major ranked-session block.

areas.name: Tutorial and Core Techniques
areas.location_cue: The Tutorial menu and a controlled low-pressure arena.
areas.note: Both lessons and the three specialized techniques are verified before cumulative multiplayer work.

levels.1: Use the training menu before relying on a live teammate.
levels.2: Complete the basic tutorial from its first prompt to the completion screen.
levels.3: Choose tutorial slot #1, perform every requested movement, cover, crawl, ranged, melee, jammer, shield, grenade, and objective action that appears, then remain until the menu records the basic lesson as complete.

levels.1: Use the training menu before relying on a live teammate.
levels.2: Complete the advanced tutorial from its first prompt to the completion screen.
levels.3: Choose tutorial slot #2, perform every requested movement, cover, crawl, ranged, melee, jammer, shield, grenade, and objective action that appears, then remain until the menu records the advanced lesson as complete.

levels.1: The close-range system includes a precisely timed reversal.
levels.2: Use the advanced lesson or a controlled match to perform one melee counter.
levels.3: Ready the Brainer, wait for an opposing melee attack to begin, and trigger the counter during its active approach. Confirm the counter animation and result rather than counting an ordinary melee elimination.

levels.1: Charged melee movement has its own distance record.
levels.2: Run a cumulative 100 metres while the Brainer is heated.
levels.3: Equip a Brainer that can be charged, hold the charge until it heats, and sprint safely in repeated stretches. Keep the weapon charged during movement until the cumulative 100-metre record appears.

levels.1: One grabbed creature can protect the front of the operator.
levels.2: Grab a compatible creature as a shield and eliminate an opposing player while still holding it.
levels.3: Switch to the handgun, grab a standard compatible creature from the front, keep the shield alive, aim around it, and score one player elimination before releasing or executing the held creature.

areas.name: Final Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: Tutorial records, Experiment tree, ranked statistics, U-Trials, weapon levels, map and mode records, and customization menus.
areas.note: Run this only after every preceding entry is complete or a service-disabled promotional row has dated evidence.

levels.1: The Experiment tree and tutorial menu expose all finite solo content.
levels.2: Confirm two tutorial slots, 24 Experiment clears, four S ranks, and every mission reward.
levels.3: Inspect both tutorial records and all main and bonus Experiment tiles. Verify the three bonus branches plus final slot show S, every reward-bearing result added its cosmetic, and every fixed loadout was used.

levels.1: The played-map and mode records reveal gaps in the online rotation.
levels.2: Confirm all nine maps and all ten named mode or ruleset entries have completed results.
levels.3: Review One Life, all eight Multi-Mission rules, 4 Survivors, ranked and free match checks, then compare the nine-map list with the final client selector. Replay any tile or ruleset missing a stored result.

levels.1: Eight tabs should be completely illuminated.
levels.2: Confirm all 48 U-Trials show Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
levels.3: Open each of the eight category tabs and verify six rows with four lit medals apiece, for 192 total. The 500 ranked matches, rank 60, weapon-level, and cumulative combat totals must all be stored.

levels.1: Firearm levels and customization rows are split across several tabs.
levels.2: Confirm all 36 usable tools and 34 attachment rows are owned and tested.
levels.3: Cycle every PDW, shotgun, handgun, Brainer, knife, grenade, sight, reticle, and suppressor entry. Standard firearms should display level 20; supplied-level entitlement weapons require ownership and one completed-use record.

levels.1: Rank, trials, updates, DLC, and the Portal all feed the same appearance menus.
levels.2: Confirm 15 progression equipment pieces, 60 I.C.O.N.s, update gear, both DLC packs, and every finite displayed row.
levels.3: Open every customization category, equip each owned row once, and compare against the numbered entries in this pack. Preserve dated evidence for any Portal-only promotion that is no longer claimable.

levels.1: The online-only ledger is the least replaceable part of completion.
levels.2: Capture rank, 500-match total, wins, U-Trials, weapon levels, maps, modes, and owned cosmetics.
levels.3: At the final profile state, take dated captures of every statistics and customization page, close the game normally, and copy local Steam data. Relaunch once to confirm the final record still loads.
